title_zh: 海风较大时选择岸上游览

scenario.goal_zh: 比较海边游览方式并决定是否乘船。

context_zh: 两位游客在码头向船长了解游船状况，并比较搭船和沿岸步行。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: Is the boat trip still going ahead in this wind?

sentences.speaker: Captain Moss
sentences.text: Yes, but it will be a bumpy ride today.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: I saw a wave come right over the front of that smaller boat.

sentences.speaker: Captain Moss
sentences.text: Ours is bigger, but you may still get wet. I am the captain, and I would rather you knew that before buying a ticket.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: Could we walk to the lighthouse instead?

sentences.speaker: Captain Moss
sentences.text: Certainly. Follow the path straight ahead. It takes about twenty minutes.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: That sounds better for us. We will walk today and try the boat another time.

sentences.speaker: Captain Moss
sentences.text: No problem. The path starts just beyond the ticket office.
